thesis.final_decision: whether to proceed to implement, review and only then request separate explicit economic authorization (Issue #810) for attempt 3 of the frozen funding-carry paper screen. This packet is a pre-implementation protocol pre-registration (timing tolerances, collection-failure policy, run identity). It authorizes no seal, launch, storage probe, network access, order or economic run, and no code change other than the single behaviour-preserving constant named in implementation_head.
thesis.hypothesis: The economic hypothesis is exactly that of the attempt-2 packet (digest 617988282ad6dfbf0ee7188f002676a1675dfac38c9ac969071bee3091b2e770): a matched BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT spot-long / USD-M perpetual-short carry with fixed monthly equal-quantity targets (gross 0.5, common lot 0.001, irreversible 10% drawdown stop), executed only against later recorded depth under the declared fees and adverse-price assumptions, earns positive net virtual-USDT profit above recorded fees over a fresh ninety-day window, positive in each of three thirty-day blocks, with nonzero funding receipts in every block, while staying flat at the terminal close. Attempt 3 changes no economic parameter and no economic acceptance criterion. Any reused 2023-2024 development replay of the same fixed family is reused-development evidence only and is not evidence for the prospective window; no development economic outcome is recorded in this packet.
thesis.economic_mechanism: Unchanged from the attempt-2 packet: when the perpetual funding rate is positive, long perpetual holders pay short holders at each published settlement (00:00, 08:00 and 16:00 UTC); a spot-long / perpetual-short pair of equal quantity hedges price exposure and collects the transfer, net of two-venue taker fees, depth-limited adverse fills and basis or hedge-break risk. The decision chain (source, availability, feature_state, model_strategy, intent, order, fill, accounting, evidence, decision) is the attempt-2 chain. What attempt 3 adds is an explicit, result-blind specification of two operational layers that decide whether an observation window is usable evidence: the timing tolerances of the public-data freshness checks, and the response to a collection failure. Both are justified from venue and engineering mechanism only: the time a public REST response needs, the cross-request skew inside one capture, the decision-to-execution window of the paper engine and the frozen 180-second observation-gap limit. No attempt-1 or attempt-2 timing, price, equity or outcome figure was read or used.
thesis.counter_hypothesis: A positive paper result, if any, is explained by something other than a repeatable carry edge: every alternative of the attempt-2 packet (selection of the carry family on seen development data, a single ninety-day regime, optimistic fills at 10% of displayed depth with a flat 5bp adverse buffer and no queue or latency, receipt-time-only spot depth, mark-to-mid spot valuation, funding-rate compression, or an operational artifact), plus the following attempt-3 specific alternatives. (1) Restart selection: attempt 3 exists because attempt 2 ended; if the restart were conditioned on an observed attempt-2 outcome it would be optional stopping. Mitigation: attempt 2 ended from a software defect found in the failure marker, no attempt-2 outcome is read or used, and the attempt-2 root stays unevaluated. (2) Staler quotes: the reader now accepts a capture that was within five seconds at completion and consumed up to ten seconds later, so a venue-stamped mark can be fifteen seconds old at valuation; the flat 5bp adverse buffer is not calibrated to that age, so staler fills may be systematically favourable or unfavourable. (3) Skip selection: slots skipped by the collection policy may coincide with fast or illiquid markets, so the retained observation set may be biased toward calm periods; retries accept a later capture in place of a failed one. The skip budget bounds but does not remove this. (4) Post-hoc tolerance fitting: tolerances could be tuned until a capture succeeds; they are therefore bound to the source constants by a test and may not change after a seal.
thesis.information_gain: Pre-registering the tolerances and the failure policy before any attempt-3 data exists means an INVALID outcome is classified by ex-ante rules rather than post hoc, and a valid ninety-day window can falsify the economic hypothesis exactly as in the attempt-2 packet. A rejected frozen screen is a valid failed-hypothesis outcome. A pass shows only that this one window met the frozen criteria under paper assumptions.
thesis.cheapest_falsifier: Ordered by cost. (i) The source-constant binding test, which fails if any pre-registered timing value diverges from the code (exists now, no network). (ii) An owner decision on the collection policy, which can reject or change the proposal before anything is built. (iii) Fake-transport collector tests that inject each failure class, each budget breach and a retry that would exceed the ten-second decision window; these are required for the implementation packet and are not written yet. (iv) For the economic hypothesis there is no cheaper falsifier than the frozen screen itself, run once on fresh data; opening unused or additional data, or any attempt-1 or attempt-2 data, to pre-test it is forbidden.
thesis.stop_rule: Do not implement the collection policy as a sealed behaviour, seal, launch, run the storage probe or touch the network under this packet. This packet is bound to an implementation_head that contains no collection-policy code, so it can never support a seal: sealing needs (a) a later implementation packet with a new implementation_head, a new digest and a fresh result-blind review, (b) explicit owner authorization on Issue #810 naming the UTC start, the run root and the digest, and (c) the owner's decision on the collection policy recorded on Issue #810. The attempt-2-only owner exception (https://github.com/shuntatsu/trade_rl/issues/810#issuecomment-6680576996) does not extend to attempt 3, and the attempt-2 root is available, so G0 predecessor verification applies in the ordinary way. After a later authorized seal, an INVALID event (any permanent failure marker, a Class D or Class I failure, a budget breach, an observation gap over 180 seconds, changed source or runtime identity, clock reversal, an unmatched hedge, drawdown at or above 10%, or a late, missing, revised or out-of-order funding settlement) ends the attempt: no resume, repair or backfill. A failed screen is not rescued by changing criteria, window, symbols, costs, participation, stop level or tolerances. If attempt 3 is INVALID or rejected, a further attempt needs a new lineage, a new packet, a new review and a new seal, and the carry line stops if the economic screen itself is rejected.
thesis.metric_proxy_rationale: Unchanged from the attempt-2 packet: net marked virtual-USDT equity change against the declared zero-interest cash comparison on the canonical ledger, with once-charged fees, depth-based adverse fills, funding by published settlement time and actual simulated exits, requiring positive net profit, positive return in each thirty-day block, net profit above recorded fees, observed maximum drawdown below 10% and funding receipts in every block. It is a paper proxy; minute sampling is not an intraminute drawdown or liquidity guarantee.
thesis.limitations: Attempt 2 (screen start 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z; frozen checkout C:\trade_rl_frozen\attempt2-d649fe05; run root C:\trade_rl_runs\attempt2\root-20261107) is INVALID: its collector halted at cycle 61 (2026-11-07T00:59:07Z) and wrote collection-failure.json, because read_forward_snapshot re-applied the five-second per-quote age bound at the consumption time to a capture that had passed it at completion (root cause recorded on Issue #810, comment 6711911740; reader fixed by pull request #1164, merge commit cbb56debe99a86c153a185d34eb15e71c98137c0). That is a software defect found from the failure marker, not from any economic observation. Result-blindness: no attempt-1 or attempt-2 price, equity, profit, drawdown, fill or funding figure, no FS1 scoring and no unused or final data was read to write this packet, and none is used. Identity fields needed for the attempt-3 lineage (protocol digest, event count, final tip, last command time) must be read from the preserved attempt-2 root by a reader limited to those fields; the attempt-2 root, its collection-failure.json, its frozen checkout and the carry-a2 scheduled tasks are not touched by this work. Timing tolerances are taken from the source constants and from venue and engineering reasoning only; attempt-2 timing metadata (capture span, quote age, consume latency) was deliberately not used. Pre-registered values: Timing protocol parameters: quote_age_ms=5000; future_skew_ms=1000; request_seconds=5; capture_span_seconds=10; consume_latency_ms=10000; decision_window_seconds=10; depth_receipt_age_seconds=5; worst_case_mark_age_ms=15000. Collection policy parameters: retries_per_slot=2; retry_delay_seconds=2; retry_start_window_seconds=30; max_consecutive_skipped_slots=1; max_skipped_slots_per_hour=2; max_skipped_slots_total=129; cadence_seconds=60; frozen_gap_limit_seconds=180. The timing values are the current constants of trade_rl/integrations/binance/forward.py (MAX_QUOTE_AGE_MS, MAX_QUOTE_FUTURE_SKEW_MS, MAX_REQUEST_SECONDS, MAX_CAPTURE_SPAN_SECONDS, MAX_CONSUME_LATENCY_MS) and the paper decision-window and depth-receipt literals; a test fails if the packet and the source diverge. The worst-case venue-stamped mark age at valuation is quote_age_ms + consume_latency_ms = 15 s; futures depth used for a fill is at most 10 s old because the depth executor also bounds the receipt age at execution to 5 s. The collection policy values are a proposal and an owner decision point: the engineering justification is that retries are confined to one slot and never reuse or discard a consumed capture, a retry cannot fit inside the ten-second decision window and so is forbidden after a decision, one skipped slot leaves a gap near 120 s while two consecutive skipped slots reach the frozen 180-second limit, the hourly cap separates a transient from a persistent fault, and 129 is floor(129,604 / 1000), that is 0.1% of the screen's slots. The policy is NOT implemented at implementation_head: the source still halts permanently on the first collection failure and the assessor still rejects any failed capture. The policy therefore also relaxes one attempt-2 operational-quality clause (a failed capture rejects the screen) into a bounded, registered budget; this is pre-registered before any attempt-3 data, relaxes no economic criterion, and needs the implementation packet, a carry_paper_screen_v3 plan whose economic fields equal carry_paper_screen_v2, and an attempt-lineage version that can name attempt 2 as predecessor. Run identity: run root C:\trade_rl_runs\attempt3\root-<UTC seal date YYYYMMDD>, storage-probe scratch root C:\trade_rl_runs\attempt3\storage-probe-<UTC date YYYYMMDD>, frozen checkout C:\trade_rl_frozen\attempt3-<first 8 hex of the launch commit>, scheduled tasks carry-a3-supervisor and carry-a3-check; none of these exists yet. The attempt-2 seal and protocol digest are never reused and the attempt-3 protocol digest must differ from every earlier digest. The seal, start time, authorization comment and launch commit are PENDING_OWNER_AUTHORIZATION; no seal was computed. Packet heads: protocol_head and implementation_head are the last commit that changes trade_rl/ in the pull request that adds this packet (a behaviour-preserving constant refactor); the packet is committed in a later descendant, so the pull request head is not the implementation_head and tools.research_assurance_github cannot report PASS for this in-tree packet. Review route: the attempt-2 same-account exception does not apply; the ordinary route (a different authenticated GitHub principal) applies unless the owner records a new explicit decision. No PASS is claimed. Paper trading establishes no queue position, latency, venue account rules, larger-capital liquidity, intraminute risk, production eligibility or live safety, and the per-instrument rules are current-metadata snapshots valid for at most one hour.

authorities.unit: Unchanged from the attempt-2 packet (digest 617988282ad6dfbf0ee7188f002676a1675dfac38c9ac969071bee3091b2e770): signed integer-lot quantities on the intersection of LOT_SIZE and MARKET_LOT_SIZE, common lot 0.001, venue minimum notional, equal-quantity matched hedge.
authorities.time: trade_rl/integrations/binance/forward.py and forward_evidence.py: every venue-stamped quote is within the quote-age and future-skew bounds at its receipt and again at capture completion; one request, one capture span and the consumption of a snapshot each have a separate bound and a separate reference time; quotes are not re-aged against the later decision time. Timing protocol parameters: quote_age_ms=5000; future_skew_ms=1000; request_seconds=5; capture_span_seconds=10; consume_latency_ms=10000; decision_window_seconds=10; depth_receipt_age_seconds=5; worst_case_mark_age_ms=15000. Other time rules are unchanged: decision before executable quote, 180-second observation gap, half-open screen window [start, close), funding assigned by published settlement time, seal at least five minutes before start.
authorities.state: Unchanged state authority (canonical BookState driven by the PaperEngine from a protocol-bound append-only journal) plus a proposed durable registry of collection attempts and skipped slots beside the cycle acknowledgement of the control database, so that a failed or retried capture is recorded exactly once and an unregistered failure cannot be mistaken for an allowed skip. A skipped slot appends no financial command.
authorities.sign: Unchanged from the attempt-2 packet: buys reduce and sells increase cash, fees always reduce equity, funding applies to the signed quantity held strictly before the settlement timestamp.
authorities.risk: Unchanged from the attempt-2 packet: irreversible 10% drawdown stop, permanent stop on hedge mismatch, collateral checks before newly known funding, frozen close as a permanent zero target.
authorities.execution: Unchanged from the attempt-2 packet: recorded-depth executor, at most 10% of displayed size, weighted price plus a fixed 5bp adverse buffer, 10bp spot and 5bp perpetual taker fee once, no atomic two-leg fill. The 5bp buffer is not recalibrated to the 10-second futures-depth age.
authorities.accounting: Unchanged from the attempt-2 packet: one canonical BookState ledger, positions valued at spot mid and perpetual mark, never at a transient fill price.
authorities.evidence: The sealed plan keeps every economic field of carry_paper_screen_v2 and proposes carry_paper_screen_v3 whose only change is the collection-quality clause, plus an attempt-lineage version naming attempt 2 as an available predecessor. Collection failure classes. Class D (denial: HTTP 401, 403, 418, 429 or 451, or any authorization, rate-limit or geo denial) and Class I (integrity: provenance, protocol digest, clock reversal, journal or lock error, malformed or oversized response, crossed or unsorted book, any exception outside Class T) are never retried and end the attempt. Class T (transport timeout, connection or DNS error, HTTP 500, 502, 503 or 504, and a freshness rejection of one capture: stale or future quote, request or capture-span overrun) may be retried only inside the same slot, only before a capture has been consumed by a command, and never after a decision has been committed in that slot: a failed execution capture lets the pending decision expire and the slot is skipped. Each failed attempt keeps its failure evidence and is registered; a skipped slot is one where all attempts fail or the retry start window closes. Collection policy parameters: retries_per_slot=2; retry_delay_seconds=2; retry_start_window_seconds=30; max_consecutive_skipped_slots=1; max_skipped_slots_per_hour=2; max_skipped_slots_total=129; cadence_seconds=60; frozen_gap_limit_seconds=180. A breach of any skip budget, or any failure outside Class T, writes the permanent failure marker. A failed rules refresh does not skip a slot while the held rules are no older than one hour. No settlement-specific tolerance is added: the frozen rule that funding first received more than 180 seconds after a settlement is a permanent quality failure continues to apply, and a skipped slot cannot extend it. A death inside a cycle is still never resumed. Evaluation audits that every failed capture directory is registered and within budget, in addition to the attempt-2 audits. The attempt-2 protocol, seal and lineage are not reused; the attempt-3 lineage must be read from the preserved attempt-2 root.

time.statement: A snapshot accepted at capture completion is not re-aged against the later consumption time; consumption is bounded separately by the decision window; a single request, a capture span and a quote each have their own bound and reference time; and each pre-registered tolerance in this packet equals the source constant it names.
time.counterexample: A slow but legal 5.62-second capture consumed 0.6 s after completion, consumption one millisecond beyond the ten-second window, consumption before completion, a quote 5.07 s old at completion, a packet value edited to differ from its constant, and a request-duration literal that drifts away from the named constant.
time.oracle: tests/integrations/test_binance_forward_evidence.py (the 5.62-second incident timing, the inclusive ten-second bound, the request-duration constant and the paper decision-window source pins) and tests/evaluation/test_paper_attempt3_assurance_packet.py, which parses the packet values and compares them with the imported constants and with the depth-executor and account source literals.
time.known_limitations: Source-constant binding proves the packet states the code, not that the tolerances are economically adequate; the depth-executor and decision-window values are source-text pins of literals in sealed paper code; spot REST depth has no exchange timestamp; the 5bp buffer is not calibrated to quote age; synthetic timelines do not establish venue latency.

state.statement: A retried or skipped capture is registered exactly once in a durable record beside the cycle acknowledgement, appends no financial command and cannot be replayed as an executed fill; restart still halts on an unacknowledged cycle.
state.counterexample: A crash between a failed attempt and its registration, a registered skip with no failure evidence, failure evidence with no registration, a retry after a committed decision, and a retry that reuses a consumed capture.
state.oracle: Existing journal and control oracles (tests/evaluation/test_paper_control.py, tests/evaluation/test_paper_journal.py, tests/evaluation/test_paper_engine.py) cover the unchanged cycle acknowledgement and replay. The attempt registry has no implementation and no test yet; fake-transport tests injecting each counterexample are required before an implementation packet and are listed as missing evidence.
state.known_limitations: The registry does not exist at implementation_head, so this boundary is NOT_ESTABLISHED at G2 for the new part; the existing oracles establish only the unchanged halting behaviour.

evidence.statement: The sealed plan binds every economic field of the attempt-2 plan unchanged; the only relaxation is that a failed capture rejects the screen only when it is unregistered or breaches a pre-stated budget; every budget is derived from the frozen cadence, the frozen 180-second gap limit and the screen slot count; the attempt-2 seal is not reusable; and the run identity is new.
evidence.counterexample: A skip budget raised after the seal, a plan whose economic fields differ from carry_paper_screen_v2, an unregistered failed capture directory, two consecutive skipped slots, a skip budget that exceeds the screen's slot count, a protocol digest equal to an attempt-2 digest, and a run root beneath the attempt-2 root.
evidence.oracle: tests/evaluation/test_paper_attempt3_assurance_packet.py checks the policy arithmetic against the frozen cadence, gap limit and slot count, the new run-identity naming, the PENDING_OWNER_AUTHORIZATION fields and that no seal digest is recorded; the attempt-2 assessment and sealing oracles (tests/evaluation/test_paper_assessment.py, tests/evaluation/test_paper_attempt2.py) stay the oracle for the unchanged economic fields. A v3-versus-v2 plan equality test, an evaluator test for registered versus unregistered failures and a lineage test naming attempt 2 are missing evidence.
evidence.known_limitations: No screen v3, lineage version or evaluator change exists yet; the skip budgets are proposed values chosen from mechanism and engineering reasoning, not measured, and the right values are an owner decision; skip selection bias toward calm periods is bounded, not removed; the lineage fields remain caller assertions and the seal token is a caller contract, not authentication.

evidence.independent_reconstruction: Software-level only, inherited from the attempt-2 packet: the separate Decimal reference ledger and the offline evaluate replay. This packet adds no new reconstruction. The booleans describe what is established now, not the intended design: common_accounting, hard_risk, terminal_state and multi_symbol are enforced by the unchanged frozen screen and ledger; point_in_time, realistic_costs, fit_development_unused_separated and multi_period are not established. No prospective observation of attempt 3 exists. The collection policy has no implementation to reconstruct.

claims.decision_rule: Do not seal attempt 3 under this packet. A later implementation packet may support a seal only if it has a review of its exact digest and heads that finds no blocking issue, the owner has decided the collection policy and authorized the seal on Issue #810, and the attempt-2 predecessor is verified from its preserved root. After such a seal the frozen economic screen is evaluated once offline at close plus 180 seconds and qualifies only if net profit is positive and exceeds recorded fees, each of the three thirty-day blocks has positive return and a nonzero funding receipt, observed maximum drawdown is below 10%, observation gaps never exceed 180 seconds, there is no unregistered quality failure or nonterminal stop, all four instruments filled, positions are actually flat with no pending intent, and no nonzero funding settled at or after close; any other outcome rejects the screen. A pass keeps production_eligible false and is not live authorization.
